name.zh-TW: 選單設定：調整系統選單
name.en-US: Menu Settings: Adjust the System Menu

title.zh-TW: 這棵樹是全系統權限的基準
title.en-US: This tree is the basis for permissions across the system

description.zh-TW: 從「系統管理 → 選單設定」進來。這裡維護的是「資源」——角色管理那張權限表的項目就是從這棵樹來的。資源由系統內建、跟著新功能一起上線，這一頁不能新增或刪除，只能調整名稱、順序、層級與是否顯示。左側選單看得到什麼，則是由你對這些資源有沒有權限決定的。
description.en-US: You get here from "System Management → Menu Settings". What you maintain here are "resources": the items in the permission table in Role Management come from this tree. Resources are built into the system and arrive with new features, so you can't add or delete them on this page; you can only change their names, order, levels and visibility. What appears in the left menu, in turn, depends on whether you have permission for these resources.

title.zh-TW: 四件事先知道，可以少踩幾個坑
title.en-US: Know these four things first to avoid some pitfalls

description.zh-TW: 最關鍵的是第四點：資源由後端種子資料建立，這一頁只能調整，不能新增或刪除。權限是靠資源代碼對應到各個功能頁面的，代碼不會變——所以改名或搬移不會影響誰能用哪個功能，第三點說的完整名稱改寫，只會改變角色管理權限表上看到的名稱。
description.en-US: The most important is the fourth one: resources are created by the back-end seed data, so this page can only adjust them, not add or delete them. Permissions are matched to each feature page by the resource code, which never changes. Renaming or moving a node therefore doesn't affect who can use which feature; the full-name rewrite in the third point only changes the names shown in the permission table in Role Management.

title.zh-TW: 搜尋會關掉拖曳，這是刻意的
title.en-US: Searching turns off dragging, and that's intentional

description.zh-TW: 搜尋只影響畫面顯示，不會改變要儲存的內容——儲存送出的永遠是完整的樹。也因為搜尋後看到的順序不是真正的順序，這時拖曳會被停用，避免你照著篩選後的畫面排出錯誤的次序。要調整順序請先清掉搜尋。
description.en-US: Search only affects what's shown, not what will be saved: saving always submits the whole tree. And because the order you see after searching isn't the real order, dragging is disabled while searching, so you don't end up arranging items in the wrong order based on a filtered view. To change the order, clear the search first.

title.zh-TW: 拖曳只在同一層有效，換層級要用選單裡的功能
title.en-US: Dragging only works within one level; changing levels needs a separate action

description.zh-TW: 拖曳能做的只有調整同一層之間的先後順序。要把一個節點移到別的層級底下，請用該列的「移到其他層級」——那個對話框會告訴你會一起搬走幾個子項目、名稱會如何重寫，也會擋掉搬進自己子孫裡這種無效的移動。每一列還可以就地改名和切換顯示狀態；被停用的節點在角色管理的權限表上仍然看得到，只是會標示「選單已停用」，權限設定不會因此消失。
description.en-US: Dragging can only change the order of items within the same level. To move a node under a different level, use "Move to Another Level" on its row. That dialog tells you how many child items will move with it and how their names will be rewritten, and it blocks invalid moves, such as moving a node into one of its own descendants. You can also rename each row in place and switch its visibility. A disabled node is still shown in the permission table in Role Management, just marked "Menu Disabled", and its permission settings aren't lost.

title.zh-TW: 改了很多步，但只有這一下會寫進系統
title.en-US: You can make many changes, but only this click saves them

description.zh-TW: 改名、切換顯示、拖曳排序與搬移，在按下儲存之前都只存在於畫面上。畫面上方會出現黃色提示，列出你目前累積了幾筆更新、幾筆位置變動，旁邊的「全部還原」可以一次退回載入時的狀態。反過來說，中途離開或重新整理，這些變更就沒了——改完記得儲存。
description.en-US: Renames, visibility changes, drag-and-drop reordering and moves exist only on screen until you click "Save". A yellow notice appears at the top of the page showing how many items you've updated and moved so far, and "Revert All" next to it takes everything back to how it was when loaded. On the other hand, if you leave or refresh the page partway through, these changes are lost, so remember to save when you're done.
